title: Rowlett's newest fire and police station is open at Sapphire Bay
excerpt: Station No. 5 puts firefighters and police officers right where Rowlett is growing fastest.
coverAlt: Station No. 5 now open at Sapphire Bay
body:
Rowlett's southeast side has a new neighbor, and it's one we're all glad to have.

Fire and Police Station No. 5 opened this spring at 1301 Easy Street, near the Sapphire Bay development on Lake Ray Hubbard. Residents, city leaders and first responders turned out for the ribbon cutting on April 10.

It's the first new police facility Rowlett has built since 1994. Firefighters and police officers share the building, including a fitness room that helps both departments stay ready.

The bigger win is speed. With new homes, restaurants and attractions going up along the waterfront, having help stationed close by means faster response for Sapphire Bay, Bayside and the neighborhoods around them.

If you're near Easy Street, give a wave to the crews. They're there for all of us.
